recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any desire for deeper nested-extension examples or ElementDefinition.id attributes in tutorial snippets should be handled as a separate current Jira/work-group decision rather than as unfinished FHIR-7804 work.
issue_request: FHIR-7804 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core DSTU1 change request asking for better extension documentation and examples, especially simple primitive and complex nested extension structures. The problem report called out the old non-real trial-status example and the need for an inspectable nested-extension example; the accepted resolution was to add more examples.
initial_application: The issue was applied by git commit 1a0d7e31b50d92270bc4563b315a23feeca892cd, the git-svn import of SVN revision 6521, which replaced the old acme trial-status material in source/extensibility.html with patient-clinicalTrial nested extension examples. Later source reorganization moved the tutorial content to source/extensibility-examples.html, and later same-family work expanded the example set.
additional_context: The active current-build examples page is source/extensibility-examples.html, listed in publish.ini. It now includes a simple Patient participation-agreement extension, an iso21090-EN-qualifier example on a primitive HumanName part, and a complex patient-clinicalTrial tutorial with definition, instance-use, and Patient profile snippets. Later FHIR-12441 removed the official HL7 patient-clinicalTrial extension, so the current tutorial intentionally uses an example.org canonical and points real clinical-trial participation toward ResearchStudy/workflow-researchstudy.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current combined-branch source already provides the inspectable extension examples requested by FHIR-7804, and reintroducing the removed official clinical-trial extension or adding redundant prose would conflict with later decisions and maintenance discipline.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive issue requested a multi-level extension example on the same extensibility examples page and is already represented on the combined branch.

Later Published/Persuasive issue requested complete simple and complex extension examples, including definition, instance, and profile surfaces; it explains the later source expansion but was not separately decided here.
Later Published/Persuasive with Modification issue removed the official HL7 patient-clinicalTrial extension, supporting the current example.org tutorial form.
